details.formulaDescription: Validate event is boston or comrades, sex is M or F, ageOnRaceDay 18–90, qualifyingTimeMinutes 1–600, and the certified flag is boolean. For Boston, look up the age-group row from the BAA 2027/2028 standards table; M follows the men's column and F the women's column. For Comrades the open requirement is 300 minutes. bufferMinutes = requirementMinutes − qualifyingTimeMinutes, rounded to the nearest minute. eligible is true only when the certified-course flag is true and qualifyingTimeMinutes ≤ requirementMinutes. missing is null when eligible; 'certified-course' when the course is not certified; 'time' when the time misses the standard. ruleNote records that meeting a Boston standard only opens an application, and that Comrades accepts only official published CMA-compliant results, not GPS or Strava splits.
assumptions: The checked result is a net chip time from an officially published, certified course; watch, GPS or Strava recordings are not valid qualifiers.
The tool applies the standards in force on 2026-11-25; future editions may revise age-group times, and registration cutoffs can exclude qualifiers who meet the standard.
The tool does not verify the qualifying-window date: whether a result falls inside the event's acceptance period must be checked against that edition's rules.
Age is interpreted as age on race day; age-group boundaries follow the official standard table, not registration age.
details.rounding: bufferMinutes rounds to the nearest whole minute; requirement and qualifying times stay in whole minutes.
